answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards earned by a new identity stay locked for, say, 30 epochs, and any slash for a bad attestation during that window claws back the whole locked balance. A farm of a thousand clones must keep every one honest for weeks, so an attacker can't mine a quick payout and echo it across accounts. Like coral slowly building a reef, trust accrues; one atlas of shared mistakes across clones exposes the cluster and burns all its pending rewards.
